sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:39

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:39:1
items.html: The foundation between Atzilut and Beria is made from Bina of Atzilut. As above in the adjacent item, that it is a screen of distancing. However, the coupling is made in ZON of Atzilut, for every lower one comes out by means of the coupling made in the Nukva of the upper one, as written on page 1903, item 20; see there; but only because it is made upon the screen of phase two, which is the screen of Bina, it is regarded as made in Bina of Atzilut, for the screen of phase two brings out the level of Bina.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:39:2
items.html: The screen between Beria and Yetzira is made from ZA of Beria. It is the screen of the window, as above in the adjacent item, the passage beginning “Is revealed.” However, the Ibur [impregnation] is made in the Nukva of Beria, for every lower one is sorted in the belly of the Nukva of the degree adjacent to it, as above (in this part, item 20); only because the coupling is made upon the screen of phase one, which is a window, which brings out ten Sefirot at the level of ZA, therefore it is called after ZA of Beria, that is, after his screen.
